svg.title: Thinking tokens are already inside the output count. In the course run the model reported 148 output tokens: 109 in the answer you see and 39 of hidden thinking, all billed at the output price of $6.00 per million. The right cost uses the 148. A common bug adds the 39 reasoning tokens again, billing 187 tokens and charging the thinking twice.
